dismissed.why_not_material: This is a minor understatement of enrollment (150 vs actual 153) in a September 2021 press release about the SIERRA trial (the catalyst trial). The company rounded down by 2% while the trial was still completing enrollment. This is not masking behavior—if anything, slightly understating enrollment goes against the pattern of a company trying to inflate expectations. The discrepancy is immaterial in magnitude and does not constitute marketing designed to mask a likely miss. It appears to be a timing/rounding artifact from using the originally estimated enrollment figure in marketing materials.

analyst_note: The single refuted finding relates directly to the catalyst trial (SIERRA Phase 3 in r/r AML) but is not material to the investment decision. The company stated 150 patients enrolled in a September 2021 release when the actual final count reached 153. This 2% understatement of enrollment—if anything—runs counter to typical pre-readout promotional inflation and likely reflects use of the original target enrollment in marketing copy. No company-level honesty red flags were identified. The registry shows primary endpoint changes and completion slippage, which are noted but not independently analyzed here. Absent findings suggesting data manipulation, endpoint gaming, or sponsor-level misconduct, the marketing profile is consistent with a standard Phase 3 program heading into an honest binary readout.
